requirement: Pipelined single-precision arithmetic and three input operands

test_behavior: The program includes fdiv.s and fsqrt.s; it does not independently check backpressure or branch-kill behavior.
Conversion cases observe integer destination values and flags.
The program uses flw and fsw; the comparator checks architectural memory values.
The port test checks that a division and independent additions each reach the shared write port once, with their associated values and flags.
